## Above board

**Word Power 41 · English idioms**

### Meaning

Legal and honest; without deception.

### Usage

1. Money transfer on GPay is completely above board.
2. In business Gyan Prakash is always open and above board.

### Your turn

Use “above board” in a sentence of your own. The original lesson image also includes Hindi support and illustrations.
